Grilled S'mores
You will need: 1 x Bag of EPIC Giant Toastin' Marshmallows; 1 x Jar of chocolate spread; 1 x Pack of choc-chip cookies; Grill / Oven / Warm BBQ
Cover the underside of each cookie in choc spread, place a Giant Toastin' Marshmallow flat side down on every second cookie used.
Place all the choc-covered and mallow-loaded cookies on a baking sheet, slide under the hot grill until the marshmallow begins to lightly brown and the choc spread melts.
Remove from the grill and sandwich a choc-only cookie on top of a mallow-loaded cookie... Squidge down and serve immediately!
Caution! Be safe
Hot marshmallows can be a burning or choking hazard
